original_goal:
[Module: Transfer Funds | TC-018 | Type: Edge/Interaction | Priority: Medium]
Title: Browser Back after successful transfer does not create a duplicate

▶ Start URL:    http://localhost:8080/transfer-funds
▶ Requires Auth: Yes
▶ Test Data:
{
  "amount": "2500.00",
  "source_account": "****5001 (Checking, $5,847.52)",
  "destination_account": "****5002 (Savings, $25,678.90)"
}

Preconditions:
  User is logged in; source account (****5001 Checking) has at least 2× the transfer amount available

Steps to Execute:
  1. Complete a successful transfer of '2500.00' from '****5001 (Checking, $5,847.52)' to '****5002 (Savings, $25,678.90)'; note the transaction ID displayed
  2. Press the browser Back button
  3. Click 'Transfer' again without changing any inputs

Expected Result:
  Second submission is blocked; only one transaction ID exists in history; no duplicate transfer occurs

Notes from prior verification:
  Precondition uses seeded balances: ****5001 has $5,847.52 which is > 2× $2,500. Conditional/behavioral steps (browser history) are runtime checks and cannot be validated by static DOM; test relies on backend/idempotency handling.
expected_outcome: Second submission is blocked; only one transaction ID exists in history; no duplicate transfer occurs
